Game Overview

In 4 Colors Multiplayer, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the fast-paced card game action of 4 Colors Multiplayer. Strategically match colors and numbers while deploying clever action cards. Whether you're facing friends or AI, outmaneuver your rivals and be the first to clear your hand. Remember to call out when you’re down to one card!
